description.value:
Validation of scenario 1.2b of the eOverdracht 4.0 Receive use case. See [the test file on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/vpk:V4.0_validatiegegevens_overdracht_ontvangend) for more information.
Scenario 1.2b for eOverdracht receiving systems. This scenario assumes that there is no negotiation phase ('aanmeldfase').

nts:include.description: At the sending XIS, the Task resulting from the negotiation phase is updated with a reference to the nursing handoff Composition on Task.input.

nts:include.name: Await nursing handoff addition notification
nts:include.description: The sending XIS sends a notification to the receiving XIS because the Task has been updated with a reference to the nursing handoff Composition.

description.value: Retrieve the nursing handoff Composition and check the request. The receiving XIS should perform a read on the Task after receiving a notification that the Task has been updated.

Retrieve the nursing handoff Composition and check the request. After reading the Task, the receiving XIS should detect that a reference to the nursing handoff Composition has been added and subsequently perform a read to retrieve this Composition.
Complete the eOverdracht Task and check the request. This should be an update operation where the original Task is sent, with only the status element changed.
Confirm that the Task resource contains 1 Composition reference for the nursing handoff.
